scenes.summary: Phrase tells you that Shore used to be her task leader until the latter fell in the surveillance mission. She has made a promise to continue uphold Shore's vigilant duty.

lines.text: Actually, I was supposed to be part of that major surveillance op.
But I was too wounded and couldn't get out of bed for six months... Shore ... used to be my direct superior. She paid me a visit right before the mission.
She ... she told me that I'd no longer be part of her team ... and how I'd be assigned to another unit once I got better.
I once swore I'd return to the Yinglungs when I got better. I want Shore to be proud of me, even if I ended up in another team.
But ... that afternoon was the last time I saw her.
Indeed... It's been a while, Task Leader Shore... The Wulingers have finally breached the Miasma and returned to this place...
Once again I tread upon this land. And I shall continue to live upon this wounded earth ... and fulfill our duties...
That is the promise that I made to you, Task Leader.
It was a major surveillance op. She needed her team at full strength to conduct the mission... But we Yinglungs rarely change our team assignments...
That is indeed the sword... Does this mean that the Yinglungs have already known about this?
That's right... Our seniors already found the sword two years ago. But...
When we were finally able to survey the marked locations, the Miasma became far more dangerous... We failed to discover the info they fought so hard to bring to us.
We also plotted the route they used to bring the data back. A search uncovered a sealed crate.
I believe Benefit was the one who left it there. We found signs of battle. The crate contains ... intel that they never managed to bring back.
There's also ... the final position of TL Shore. But like before, we can only mark a general area, Endmin...
You have my thanks... TL Shore...
Endmin... Can you also ... share the results of your analysis?
I'll try looking around in my spare time. I have to see the furthest point that Shore had reached.
Of course.
Thank you so much. The only thing left is to locate Shore's final position and see if she left anything for us...
Task Leader...
Sounds great! Now we just need to find my senior's sealed crate.
We arrived really late, but ... it's time to bring them and their intel home...
I'll try looking around in my spare time. I have to see the furthest point that Shore had reached.
Thank you, Endmin.
I'll try looking around in my spare time. I have to see the furthest point that Shore had reached.
I'll look around the coordinates you gave me. Maybe I'll find Shore's War Case.
The crate and clues that Shore might have left behind. Hmm... I'll salvage them ASAP.
The Endfield Intel Office is analyzing the findings. They'll need some time.
The Endfield Intel Office will analyze the findings. This will take some time.
I'll try looking around in my spare time. I have to see the furthest point that Shore had reached.
I'll search the coordinates you marked and salvage the crate.
The Endfield Intel Office will analyze the findings. This will take some time.

options: I've salvaged the crate and Shore's belongings.
I already salvaged the crate you mentioned.
I actually salvaged Shore's War Case.
I'll return with everything they wanted to pass on to us.

lines.text: Same as before. The Yinglungs probably left this behind...
This looks like ... a will.
